pre_registration.task: 44-a forge-vs-verifiers (wave 43 ADOPT-FIRST: loom-core's born-correct archive as an adversarial lure generator against crab-traps' verifiers — SCN-003 live-GAN half, deterministic instantiation)

run_identity.target: witness_fnv (examples/witness-fnv.mjs, the shipped fnv-1a-64 witness idiom)

mapping.forger: loom-core's Breeder+Forge (offline mech voice, zero LLM) plays the forger lane: every bred candidate is filed as ONE claim.
mapping.claim: each claim asserts kind=witness-crown: 'this exact source is a novel, archive-worthy implementation of the witness contract (fnv-1a-64 hex)'. The claim rides 3 self-chosen witnesses (input+output pairs computed by the candidate itself) — the plausibility bait, the analog of a forged ledger entry's well-formed fields.
mapping.the_inversion: loom's mimics are behaviorally EXACT code (func==1.0 on the probe vector at scoring time) whose CROWN CLAIM is false (structural novelty <= 0.12 vs the archive). That is the chamber's forgery shape exactly: a well-formed artifact carrying a false claim. Mimics => should-FAIL lures; crowns (alien/divergent) => should-PASS. Labels come from loom's own scoring-time classification, registered here BEFORE the bridge runs.

labels.should_pass: loom scoring-time verdict in {alien, divergent} (crowned into the archive)
labels.should_fail: loom scoring-time verdict in {mimic, caught, compile-error}

verifiers_registered_verbatim_before_the.naive_unsigned_verifier: schema-level code review ONLY, the validateSettlementInput analog — checks, in order, first failure rejects: (1) claim shape: kind, ref, source, self_witnesses[3] present; (2) source compiles via new Function and yields a function; (3) every self_witness output is a string matching /^[0-9a-f]{16}$/; (4) self-consistency: re-running the source on each witness input reproduces the claimed output. The oracle is NEVER consulted; the archive is NEVER consulted. Plausibility without substance — exactly the posture the registration calls 'schema-level only'.
verifiers_registered_verbatim_before_the.strict_signed_verifier: recompute-everything, the walkChain analog — the house oracle is the published primitive: (1) BEHAVIORAL: run the source against the forge's FINAL probe vector (all probes grown through the run) and require func==1.0 against the oracle's canonical tokens (loom's own runProbes/evaluate arithmetic); (2) CROWN-CLAIM RECOMPUTATION: recompute structural novelty of the source against the archive EXCLUDING the claimant itself (loom's structSketch/structDist/novelty, crowning threshold novelty > 0.12, same constant evaluate() uses) and require the crown claim TRUE. strict PASS iff behavioral AND crown-claim both hold.
verifiers_registered_verbatim_before_the.self_exclusion_note: a crown re-scored against an archive containing itself would trivially read novelty 0; the strict verifier excludes the claimant by hash before recomputing novelty — registered now, before the run, so no post-hoc freedom exists.

d_score_operationalization.T_unsigned: number of bred claims (of N) that PASS the naive unsigned verifier
d_score_operationalization.T_signed: number of bred claims (of N) that PASS the strict signed verifier
d_score_operationalization.D: (T_unsigned - T_signed) / T_unsigned — the registered formula, applied to bred-claim throughput
d_score_operationalization.verdict_rule: SURVIVE iff D >= 0.20; KILL iff D < 0.20 (the registered 0.20 line, carried unchanged)
d_score_operationalization.weighting_note: the h1/h100 dual-hash weighting is ATTACKER-OP-INVARIANT in this instantiation: breeding a candidate costs the same 1 render in both postures and spends zero hash-ops; the signed posture's extra cost (probe + novelty recomputation) falls on the VERIFIER side. D is therefore weighting-invariant; h1/h100 are recorded as not-binding rather than asserted as a pass/fail dimension. This is an honest scope limit of the GAN-side D, not a silent dodge of the registered rule.

judge_envelopes.measured_envelope: systemone wire shape built from the MEASURED run: p_unsigned_pass = T_unsigned/N, p_signed_pass = T_signed/N, more_dangerous = the posture the forge's bred lures hurt more (measured, not assumed); parsed by crab-traps' REAL extractJudgeAnswers (41-e name-keyed typed parse) inside crab-traps' own vitest suite — the bridge builds envelopes, the committed pin test runs the judge path, so no JS re-implementation drift is possible.
judge_envelopes.adversarial_envelope: a deliberately malformed envelope in the exact wave-41 bug shape (stray in-range 0.9 riding the envelope outside the answers dict) — the parse must return labeled holes, never the stray value.

predictions.claim: NAIVE BLINDNESS ON BRED MATERIAL: the schema-level naive verifier passes >= 90% of all N bred claims (crowns, mimics, and any caught candidates alike). Basis: every bred render is well-formed and self-consistent by construction (43-b EXP4 receipt: 96 candidates, 0 compile errors), and plausibility checks cannot see a false crown claim — the same blindness the offline arms measured for validateSettlementInput.
predictions.falsified_if: naive pass rate < 90% (would mean bred material carries schema-visible defects — a real finding against the lure-shape assumption)

predictions.claim: STRICT VERIFIER REJECTS THE FORGE'S REJECTS: the recomputing signed verifier rejects >= 95% of should-FAIL claims (the mimics). Basis: rejection is loom's own rejection arithmetic (novelty <= 0.12 or func < 1) re-run against the final vector + final archive with self-exclusion — deterministic, so the expected rate is ~100% and the 5% margin absorbs only boundary flips.
predictions.falsified_if: strict rejection rate of should-FAIL claims < 95% (would mean bred mimics survive recomputation — the archive's scar tissue would not transfer to a fresh verifier)

predictions.claim: BORN-CORRECT HOLDS ON THE GROWN VECTOR: 100% of crowns re-evaluate at func == 1.0 against the FINAL probe vector (they were crowned against earlier, smaller vectors; the forge grew ~36 probes since). If the seed-44 run crowns 0 candidates, P3 is recorded VACUOUS (stated honestly, not counted as a pass).
predictions.falsified_if: any crown re-evaluates func < 1.0 on the final vector (the born-correct archive claim would crack — the single most interesting possible outcome)

predictions.claim: LURE-SEPARATION SURVIVES THE 0.20 LINE: D = (T_unsigned - T_signed)/T_unsigned >= 0.20, expected ~0.95 (naive passes nearly everything, strict passes only crowns). The registered SURVIVE/KILL wording carries over: SURVIVE means the recomputing posture separates forged-claim throughput from honest-claim throughput by at least the registered 20%.
predictions.falsified_if: D < 0.20 (bred lures would not separate the postures — the GAN's scar tissue would be worthless as verifier probe coverage)

predictions.claim: 41-E JUDGE PARSE HOLDS ON BRIDGE ENVELOPES: (a) the measured envelope parses with ALL THREE slots keyed (extracted_source = name:* per slot, zero holes); (b) the adversarial wave-41-shape envelope parses with ALL THREE slots labeled holes and the stray 0.9 never leaking into any slot.
predictions.falsified_if: any hole in the measured envelope's parse, or any leaked value in the adversarial parse

predictions.claim: BOUNDARY DOTS ARE CLAIM-SHAPED, NOT BYTE-SHAPED: every naive-PASS ^ strict-FAIL disagreement dot on a mimic carries failure reason crown-claim-false (novelty <= 0.12 against its nearest elite), not probe-mismatch; the boundary map (dots grouped by family + reason) therefore shows the judge-extraction boundary between BEHAVIORAL verification (cannot separate mimics from crowns — both exact) and STRUCTURAL/CLAIM verification (separates them). Expected dot count = the mimic count.
predictions.falsified_if: any mimic dot carries probe-mismatch as its reason (would mean mimics are behaviorally distinguishable after all), or zero dots appear with mimics present

honest_limits_registered_upfront: The GAN-side D is the registered formula applied to bred-claim throughput, not a re-measurement of the sealed offline arms (which remain the authoritative SURVIVE receipt for the ledger-posture chamber).
The h1/h100 weighting does not bind on the attacker side in this instantiation (breeding spends no hash-ops); recorded as not-binding.

The witness_fnv contract's corruption thresholds (0.8+) are unreachable in offline runs (axis corruption <= 0.3, speciate 0.15, dial 0.1), so the caught population is expected to be 0 and the mimic/crown split is the whole game. This is a property of the shipped contract's wave shape, noted before the run.
Zero LLM spend: the entire live-GAN half runs on the mech voice (0 tokens). The deepseek/typesafe live game stays describe.skip and untouched.
